painpoints.text: Stale build fingerprints forced two blind rebuild cycles: an E0425 on a just-added pub const (fabro-types settings/mod.rs re-export) and an E0063 in fabro-manifest that only appeared when a downstream crate compiled it — plain `cargo build -p <dependent>` used cached artifacts and reported green (run 01M2YVNCFP5RDFCFRW9FS42R0B, seq ~20). Fix idea: when a workspace member fails E0425/E0063 on a symbol just added to a foundation crate, `touch` the foundation crate's lib.rs before re-diagnosing.

observations: deferred-action: TS API client regen pending (local step) — `lib/packages/fabro-api-client/src/**` untouched per the generated-client boundary; the OpenAPI `RunModelSettings` schema gained nullable `first_token_timeout_secs`, so the local integrate session should run `bun run generate` with the pinned openapi-generator.

The standard `cargo dev docs refresh` regenerated `docs/public/reference/cli.mdx` with an unrelated pre-existing stale entry (`--agent-session`) — HEAD's docs check was already red for that file; kept the correction and disclosed it in the implementation summary.

Scope judgment recorded for the reviewer: the TTFT middleware enforces the budget only on `Operation::Stream` — pebble agent turns (`stream_with_context`) — because non-streaming `complete()` has no observable first-token seam; PR-title generation (`pull_request.rs`) also keeps a plain `ClientOptions::standard()` client and is out of the seed's 'stage LLM call' scope.

painpoints.text: nextest reused a stale test binary after edit_file twice this pass (run 01M2YVNCFP5RDFCFRW9FS42R0B): re-runs at ~1s executed the OLD code and re-emitted outdated panic text, nearly misdiagnosing a correct fix as wrong. Fix idea: scripts/verify.nu or the tester gate could pass `--cargo-no-reuse`/touch changed sources, or document `touch <file>` before re-running nextest in the implementer prompt next to hard rule (c).

observations: fabro-dev spa_refresh publish_failure_before_flip_leaves_old_bundle_consistent (lib/foundation/fabro-dev/src/commands/spa_refresh.rs) was a root-blind test: chmod 0o000 failure injection is void under uid 0, so the gate was deterministically red in root containers while green on dev hosts — worth an audit for other #[cfg(unix)] permission-based tests in the workspace (mirror_dist_preserves_unchanged_assets also touches unix perms but only reads metadata, unaffected).
